name: LawCast private requests - bypass cache
expression: (http.host eq "law.viento.me" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_app/immutable/") and (any(http.request.headers["cookie"][*] ne "") or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") or not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/__data.json") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not http.request.uri.path wildcard "/api/notices/*/screenshot") or http.request.uri.path in {"/notices" "/notices/changes" "/notices/semantic-search" "/status" "/discussions"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/discussions/") or http.request.uri.path wildcard "/notices/*/discussions*"))
publicRuleExpression: ((http.host eq "law.viento.me" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/proposals" "/crawling-transparency" "/announcements" "/webhook" "/license"} or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/announcements/") and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/__data.json")) or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/notices/*" and not http.request.uri.path wildcard "/notices/*/*" and not http.request.uri.path in {"/notices/changes" "/notices/semantic-search"}) or http.request.uri.path wildcard "/notices/*/og.png" or http.request.uri.path wildcard "/api/notices/*/screenshot")) and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/__data.json")) and not any(http.request.headers["cookie"][*] ne "")
